messages:
michael: Heads up — need to lock SEV rotation & ownership for our marketplace partners before next month's joint launch. Quick sync?

sabrina: Yes. Can we codify: partner-facing primary responder (partner SE), Redwood oncall secondary, eng-pager duty tertiary?

dan: Propose: SEV1 -> immediate war room (shared #partners-marketplace-sev), SEV2 -> Slack thread + async followup. Agree?

lee: Agree on SEV1 triggers: async failure >10% on production calls for >5min OR data exfil suspicion. Add any else?

julia: Add: billing-impacting failures (customers blocked from purchase) as SEV1.

michael: Cool. Who owns rotation? Proposed: Partner Solutions (sabrina) covers weekdays 9-5 PT, eng-oncall covers nights/weekends. Partner SIs need an escalation contact in their org too.

sabrina: We need a simple rotation table. Draft below — please confirm or edit:

```text
Rotation,Owner,Coverage
Weekdays 9-5 PT,Sabrina,Partner L2
Nights & Weekends,Eng-Oncall,Redwood Eng
Holidays,Oncall-Backup,Oncall Backup
```

eng-oncall-bot: pagerduty alert created -> PD service partners-marketplace. Channel #partners-marketplace-sev will be auto-joined on war-room.

dan: Also recommend an SLA playbook link: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/partner-escalation (placeholder).

sabrina: :thumbsup: I'll own updating our partner docs and notify partners tomorrow. Can someone create the shared channel and add partner leads?

lee: I'll create channel and add initial partners. will post rotation and PD runbook.

michael: Thanks. Action items: @sabrina update docs; @lee create channel & add partners; @dan update PD triggers. Close loop by EOD Friday. :spiral_calendar:
